text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I ran as hard as I could, the way I wanted to... But it wasn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't win... I'm following in Ryan's
footsteps, I
suppose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may not have won, but Mejiro Bright
still
managed to perform well at her first
classic year
G1.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Ryan... I apologize for my lack
of
strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping I would alleviate your
frustration,
Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
My frustration? Bright, what are you
talking
about?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell Mejiro Ryan about Mejiro Bright's
memory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see. I'm really thankful, Bright,
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You never had to carry that burden. If
you carry
too much on your shoulders,
you'll end up like I
did.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Like you did?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I think the reason I didn't do well
at the
Triple Crown was because I had
too much on my
mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's why you have to run for yourself.
That's the
best way you can run for the
Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Run to make yourself happy. That's more

important than anything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah... Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I... I really love you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wha?! I mean, I'm really happy to
hear
that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, do your best at the Japanese
Derby!
That means you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby... I still can't see the
path
before me.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do this together again.
Yeah, let's do it together again.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Should I continue running the way I have
been?
Or...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright ran the Satsuki Sho to
make up for
what happened in the past.
But the Japanese
Derby...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...Will be a fight for the future.
